title: Reconstruction of a normalized tower
statement:
Let $C_\bullet\in\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)$ be normalized
([sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]). Then $R\varprojlim_n C_n$ lies in
$\Dbc(T,\mathcal O_E)$, and for every $m$ the natural map

$$
\bigl(R\varprojlim_n C_n\bigr)\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{E,T}}
\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^m\longrightarrow C_m
$$

is an isomorphism in $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^m)$.

proof.text: Put $O=\mathcal O_E$, $R=\mathcal O_{E,T}$, $B_n=(O/\ell^n)_T$ and choose $\pi$. The coefficient-fiber lemma gives $\ell=u\pi^e$, the finite quotient identifications, and the two-term K-flat resolutions for both power systems. The representative lemma replaces the given coherent tower by $Q_n$ while retaining its actual finite-coefficient reduction maps and limit projections. Normalization therefore gives the quasi-isomorphisms $Q_n\otimes_{B_n}B_m\to Q_m$.

source.place: Proof paragraph, returned proof steps 1–2; assembly of the extracted nodes

proof.text: Fix $m\geq1$. By the coefficient-fiber lemma, $t=\ell$ is injective on $R$ with $R/\ell^mR=B_m$, so the Koszul--Roos comparison applies to $X=Q$ with $N=Q_m$ and $f_n$ the reduction maps. Apply the error-tower lemma to $Q$. It identifies $R\!\lim_{n\geq m}(Q_n\otimes_RK_m)\to Q_m$ as an isomorphism induced by the coefficient augmentations and original transitions. The Koszul--Roos comparison identifies its source with the restriction of $C\otimes_R^LB_m$, for $C=R\!\lim Q_n$, and identifies the composite with the restricted adjoint of the $m$th limit projection. Restriction detects isomorphisms, so this adjoint is an isomorphism in $D(B_m)$; the representative lemma's lift, which preserves the limit projections and the $e_m:Q_m\simeq C_m$, transports it to the required natural map for $C_\bullet$. The same comparison preserves quotient transitions.

source.place: Proof paragraph, returned proof steps 3–8; assembly of the extracted nodes

proof.text: Each $Q_n$ is termwise annihilated by $\ell^n=u^n\pi^{en}$. The power-torsion sheaf-limit lemma applies with $r_n=en$ and proves derived completeness of $R\!\lim Q_n$ through its canonical uniformizer reductions, hence of $C$ through the representative lemma's lift. Choose one interval $[a,b]$ containing the common cohomological and Tor bounds of the normalized tower. The Roos bound gives $H^i(C)=0$ outside $[a,b+1]$.

source.place: Proof paragraph, returned proof steps 9–11; assembly of the extracted nodes

proof.text: By the finite reduction isomorphisms already proved, $C\otimes_R^LB_N\simeq C_N$ is constructible with Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ for every $N$. The cofinal-reduction lemma now gives constructibility and the same Tor interval for every $C\otimes_R^L(O/\pi^j)_T$, hence common cohomological support $[a,b]$. Together with derived completeness, these are exactly the integral-category conditions. Thus $C\in D^b_c(T,O)$, and the natural ell-power maps have already been proved isomorphisms.
